claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Palmitoylcarnitine is a physiological long-chain acylcarnitine that is oxidized as a fatty-acid fuel and is not expected to kill cells at 2.5 uM; any apparent activity would reflect nonspecific metabolic/physicochemical effects rather than a kinase-inhibitory mechanism.
